What this tower covers

Data, Analytics & Lakehouse is the substrate tower: pipeline modernization, lakehouse architecture on Databricks and Snowflake, streaming and event-driven decisioning, executive BI, master data and cataloging, predictive analytics, and data products that generate revenue. We build for observability and lineage from day one, because intelligence is only as defensible as the data estate beneath it.

Why this tower, why now

Analytics debt is the silent killer of AI programs: duplicated pipelines, uncatalogued datasets, and batch-only refresh cycles make every model suspect. Regulators now ask where a number came from; customers ask why an app is stale; CFOs ask why the warehouse bill tripled. A governed lakehouse answers all three.

How a delivery runs

Delivery on Data, Analytics & Lakehouse is sequenced so the measurement always precedes the build: two weeks of baseline before the pilot, a scheduled gate before any scale-out, and a fortnightly reading against the signed number.
